Only import module paths inside this selected cohort are relocated to `ArtinAsphericityVendor`. Existing vendor and Mathlib imports retain their original paths.

`python3 scripts/providers/assemble.py --check` verifies byte-for-byte assembly from preserved full originals and the explicit relocation recipe. Technical verification, independent reviews and root mathematical acceptance are distinct steps. No acceptance is asserted here.
